actual_source.name: Roth.weight_le_degree_div
actual_source.source:
theorem weight_le_degree_div {r : σ → ℕ} {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hr : ∀ j, m ≤ r j) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    weight r d ≤ d.degree / m := by
  rw [weight, Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, Nat.cast_sum, Finset.sum_div]
  gcongr with j
  exact hr j

actual_source.what: If every parameter is at least a positive m, the weight is bounded by total multi-index degree divided by m.
actual_source.how: Expands total degree with Finsupp.degree_eq_sum and moves division through the sum; quotient monotonicity in the positive denominator gives each coordinate bound.
